title: First Repeated Word in a Sentence
statement: Given a sentence, return the first word that appears twice. Ignore case. If no word repeats, return null.
think: What is the task asking? Find the first word encountered for the second time.
What is the key operation? Track whether a word was already seen.
What wording signals stand out? First repeated, duplicate, word.
What is the brute force idea? For each word, search previous words.
What is the better/optimal idea? Add normalized words to a set and return on first duplicate.
What are the edge cases? Mixed case, repeated spaces, no duplicates.
What is the complexity? O(n) over the number of words.
How would I explain it in an interview? I scan the sentence word by word and return the first word whose insertion into the set fails.
algorithm: Split sentence into words removing empty entries
Normalize each word to lower case
Try to add word to HashSet
interview: I would use a HashSet because the only thing I need is whether a normalized word was already seen before.
ru: Это та же идея seen before, только не для char, а для word.
visualExplanation:
sentence = "Go home and go sleep"

important: Use Dictionary when counts are not required

gaps: Important: same pattern can apply to words, not only characters
Nice to have: explain why order matters
whyThisPattern: This is a HashSet problem because we only need to know whether a word has already appeared.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not Dictionary, because counts are unnecessary for the first repeated word.
Not Sliding Window, because there is no moving contiguous segment logic.
